_comment: Psytrance family - 8 sub-genres. Full-On carries 2x weight (the channel flagship). BPM values are the tempo-correction targets.

psytrance_fullon.label: Full-On
psytrance_fullon.desc: high-energy morning/daytime, bright melodies, punchy bass, sci-fi FX

goa_trance.label: Goa Trance
goa_trance.desc: melodic, organic analogue synths, eastern scales, 90s roots

psytrance_progressive.label: Progressive Psytrance
psytrance_progressive.desc: clean hypnotic rolling groove, daytime, gradual build-ups

psytrance_dark.label: Darkpsy
psytrance_dark.desc: fast, aggressive, nocturnal, eerie chaotic sci-fi

psytrance_forest.label: Forest Psy
psytrance_forest.desc: organic earthy FX, mysterious woodland atmosphere

psytrance_psychill.label: Psychill / Psybient
psytrance_psychill.desc: ambient chill-out, dub bass, meditative, made for resting

psytrance_zenonesque.label: Zenonesque
psytrance_zenonesque.desc: dark funky minimalist, off-beat bass, Zenon Records groove
